functions.name: SCRAPE
functions.description: Scrape a URL with Anakin and return clean markdown. Submits the scrape job and polls until it completes or fails.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The full URL of the page to scrape.

parameters.name: useBrowser
parameters.description: Use a headless browser — best for JS-heavy sites. Defaults to FALSE.

functions.name: SEARCH
functions.description: AI-powered web search with citations. Synchronous on Anakin's side (no polling). Costs 3 credits per call.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 5.

functions.name: AGENTICSEARCH
functions.description: Run Anakin's multi-stage AI research pipeline (search, scrape citations, extract structured data) and return the AI-generated summary. Submits the job and polls until it completes or fails. Costs 10 credits.

parameters.name: useBrowser
parameters.description: Use a headless browser when scraping citation pages. Defaults to TRUE.
